question: Was the individual self stainless prior to the arising of great delusion?
premises: Great delusion arises at some point in the account.
The self is described as stainless before that arising.
This description is presented as a prior condition.
inference: Therefore, the self is said to be stainless before the arising of great delusion.
uncertainties: The exact doctrinal status of this prior stainlessness is debated in context.
plain_english: Before the arising of great delusion, this individual self is said to be stainless.
